sentence: This project studies how to build and analyze quantum codes that control noise in quantum computers.
This project builds quantum computing algorithms for solving mechanics problems that involve nonlinear materials.
This project studies how the biological clocks in fungal filaments become synchronized with each other.
This project studies how the mechanical properties of the environment around cells control gene expression.
This project studies how well advisory committees use available information when they recommend whether to approve drugs and medical devices.
This project tries to increase how many people transfer from community colleges to four-year degree programs in science and engineering fields.
This project builds a computational model of how cells move through tight spaces and deform their nucleus.
This project tests whether light and magnetic stimulation, together with tiny energy-harvesting devices, can help repair damaged cells that line blood vessels.
This project builds light-based communication systems that can sense their surroundings and adjust to keep signals reliable in underground spaces.
This project studies how large language models can be used in transportation that mixes self-driving and human-operated vehicles.
This project plans a shared open-source ecosystem of tools and formats for dynamic geometry data used in robotics and autonomous systems.
This project studies how electrons move across the uneven surfaces of mixed-metal oxide materials, using fluorescence imaging and machine learning.
This project builds methods to compress large data and to analyze genomic sequences, using probabilistic models of the data.
This project studies how nitrate and other oxidized forms of nitrogen on surfaces react with sunlight to release nitrogen oxides and chlorine.
